16:9 PDF; one slide per page. Long text may need shortening.

Add a heading or text to at least one slide.
Could not save. Choose another location and try again.
Changes are saved automatically on this device.
Delete slide %1$d? Its text and image will be removed from this presentation.
Add an image to use this layout. Text-only slides use the full width.
This copy does not save space. Keep the original or adjust quality and resolution. Save only if you need the edited or converted copy.
These settings may make this video larger. Consider lower quality or resolution; the actual size will be checked after processing.
Could not complete this action. Try again or save a copy to open or share.
This output is not smaller than the original. Continue with this edited or converted copy?
PNG keeps transparency. Resizing may reduce detail; metadata is removed.
WebP may lose detail and change colors. Transparency is kept; metadata is removed. Animated WebP is not supported.
PNG has no quality setting. Adjust dimensions to change size.
One image per A4 page, fitted without cropping. Up to 100 images, 128 MiB each and 512 MiB total. Image-only PDF; no text recognition.
Sources and settings are saved on this device. Back keeps your work. Completed outputs can be restored; interrupted processing must be started again.
Could not add these images. Use JPEG / HEIC / HEIF / AVIF, PNG / BMP or still WebP within the limits. Your previous selection is kept.
Static image output; animation is removed.
Could not create this PDF. Try fewer images or lower dimensions.
Other file formats are not supported yet.
Still images only. Animated WebP / HEIF / AVIF cannot be imported.
This tool creates PDFs. Open existing PDFs with the PDF reader.
Choose a still JPEG, PNG / BMP, WebP, HEIC, HEIF or AVIF image.
Animated WebP / HEIF / AVIF is not supported. Choose a still image.
This image exceeds 100 MP or 128 MiB.
Choose an MP4 / MOV / 3GP / MKV / WebM video.
A compatible device decoder is required. Video: H.264 / HEVC 8-bit SDR / VP8. Audio: AAC / Opus / Vorbis / MP3. Output: MP4 (H.264 + AAC).
HDR video is not supported yet. Choose an SDR video.
Extra or unsupported tracks. Use one video track and at most one AAC audio track.
Video does not meet the size, duration or frame rate limits.
Cannot decode this file. It may be damaged or unsupported.
Cannot access this file. Select it again and grant access.
Not enough memory. Close other apps or choose a smaller file.
Open PDFs and use their pages.
Open a PDF and browse its pages. Your original stays unchanged.
PDF: up to 128 MiB and 2,000 pages.
A password or permission is required. This version cannot open this protected PDF.
This file is not a readable PDF. It may be damaged or unsupported.
The PDF reader stopped or timed out. Try again or choose another document.
Saving this page as PNG, JPEG or WebP creates a still image. Searchable text, links and interactive fields are not kept. This is conversion, not compression.
Pinch to zoom; drag to move the enlarged page.
Merge, extract, reorder and rotate pages.
Combine PDF pages or save selected pages as a new PDF. Text and vectors are preserved.
Up to 8 PDFs, 128 MiB in total and 2,000 pages. Originals stay unchanged.
New PDF: comments, links, bookmarks, accessibility tags and document metadata are not transferred. This is not compression or secure redaction. Review the result before sharing.
Encrypted or digitally signed PDFs cannot be edited here. Use the PDF reader instead.
PDF forms and documents with embedded attachments or portfolios are not supported by page tools. Use the PDF reader instead.
Use the current list positions, for example 1,3–5. Other pages leave the list; Undo restores them.
This device cannot decode this HEIC, HEIF or AVIF image.
HEIC/HEIF: Android 9+. AVIF: Android 12+. A compatible device decoder is required. Only the main still image is used; HDR, depth and additional images are not preserved.
A compatible device decoder is required. Video: H.264 / HEVC 8-bit SDR / VP8 / VP9 (P0 · SDR). Audio: AAC / Opus / Vorbis / MP3. Output: MP4 (H.264 / HEVC + AAC) / WebM (VP8 / VP9 (P0 · SDR) + Opus).
Invalid text or quoted table. Your previous document is kept.
Cannot decode text. Choose an encoding and select the file again.
This PDF exceeds 300 pages. The document was not shortened.
≤4 MiB · ≤2,000,000 characters · ≤5000 rows · ≤100 columns · ≤50,000 cells · ≤32,768 characters/cells · PDF ≤300 pages
Preview shows three columns. Tap a row for all cells; select a section/row for the presentation. Exports include the whole document.
Text outputs use UTF-8; table quotes and line endings are normalized. Formulas are not executed. PDF is a text/row report. Markdown is plain text.
Sources and settings are saved on this device. Back keeps your work. Completed outputs can be restored; interrupted processing must be started again.
Could not save or restore this work. Retry or select the source files again.
Processing continues when you leave this screen. You can cancel it.
Waiting for another task to finish.
Processing was interrupted. Your sources and settings are kept; try again.
Cannot open this audio. Choose a supported file with one mono or stereo audio track. Device decoder support is required.
Audio conversion failed. The device may not support this output; try another format.
M4A uses lossy AAC encoding at the selected bitrate. WAV stores decoded 16-bit PCM and can be larger; it cannot recover lost detail. Metadata and other tracks are omitted.
BMP stores uncompressed 24-bit color. Transparent areas become white; metadata is removed. Resizing may reduce detail and the file can be larger.
BMP has no quality setting. It stores uncompressed pixels; adjust dimensions to change size.
Pages have a white background. JPEG and WebP use lossy encoding; PNG preserves the rendered pixels.
Available formats depend on the device and selected settings.
HEVC MP4 may not play in every app. Re-encoding can lose detail and metadata; a smaller file is not guaranteed.
VP8 video and Opus sound at 48 kHz. Sound is re-encoded; detail and metadata may be lost. A smaller file is not guaranteed.
This device cannot encode or preview the selected format at these settings. Choose another format or adjust the settings.
This format cannot preserve this video\'s audio on this device. Choose another format.
WebM with sound requires Android 10 or newer.
WebM cannot preserve this video\'s orientation. Choose MP4.
OGG uses lossy Opus at 48 kHz and the selected bitrate. Channels are retained; other sample rates are converted to 48 kHz.
FLAC preserves decoded 16-bit PCM, sample rate and channels. Higher bit depths are reduced to 16-bit; lost detail cannot be recovered.
WAV stores decoded 16-bit PCM. M4A uses lossy AAC. Sample rate and channels are retained.
OGG output requires Android 10 or later. Choose another format.
The device cannot encode this format with the requested settings. Choose another format or bitrate.
The device cannot play this output format. Choose another format.
Output support could not be checked. Reselect the format to try again.
Metadata and other tracks are omitted. A smaller file is not guaranteed.
MP3 uses lossy LAME encoding at the selected bitrate. Sample rate and channels are retained. Unsupported combinations are unavailable; no automatic resampling.
Enter a valid range inside the source duration, with up to three decimal places.
Up to two sources play consecutively in this order. Each source is limited to 512 MiB and 10 minutes; the selected total is limited to 10 minutes.
Trim the ranges to a combined duration of 10 minutes or less.
The output settings are shown above. Different rates are resampled; mono is duplicated for stereo, and stereo is averaged for mono. OGG always uses 48 kHz. No automatic quality reduction.

Up to two clips, with a selected total of 10 minutes. The output canvas follows the first clip; other clips fit with black borders, without cropping. Joining resamples audio to 48 kHz and uses the larger channel count. Silent clips keep silence.

Ranges use original time. Speed applies to both clips and preserves audio pitch; processing may change sound quality. Fit adds black borders; fill crops the center. Preview the generated result before saving.
Times use the final video after trimming, joining and speed changes. Blank text adds nothing. Process and play the output to preview the exact result; source playback stays original.
Text starts after the video ends. Adjust its start time.
Text does not fit. Shorten it or choose a smaller text size.

The whole image keeps its proportions and transparency. Width is relative to the video; height fits inside the frame. Times use the final video. Text appears above the image. Process and play the output to preview.
Could not load the image. Your previous image and result are kept.
The image starts after the video ends. Adjust its start time.

Select a source range and place it in final video time. Added audio keeps its speed; it stops at the video end. Mixing uses 48 kHz mono/stereo. High combined levels can distort; lower the sliders. Process and play the output to preview.
Cannot add this audio. Choose a supported file with one mono/stereo audio track. The previous source and output are retained.
Added audio starts outside the final video. Adjust its start time or the video duration.
Source clips show original frames; processed output includes edits. Transfer keeps full resolution as PNG. The image tool has separate output size and quality settings.
Could not extract or transfer the frame. Try another time or video.
Silent MP4 at 30 fps. Add sound or text in the video editor.
Up to 100 frames, 0.5–60 seconds each, 10 minutes total. Images: 128 MiB each, 512 MiB total.
Replace the current video timeline with a private copy of this presentation? The presentation is kept.
Could not create or transfer the video. Check images, slide text, storage and device support, then try again.

Fit adds black borders; fill crops the center. Transparency becomes black. Lossy video may change detail and colors; image metadata and animation are not kept. Preview the generated result before saving.
Notes are excluded from PDF, video and image outputs. You can explicitly include them in PPTX. Up to 8,000 characters per slide.
Create a new 16:9 image of the selected slide. PNG and BMP have no quality setting. JPEG and WebP use lossy encoding.
Could not render this slide. Check its text and image, then try again.
Appearance-preserving PPTX: each slide is one image. Text and objects cannot be edited separately or searched as text.
Off by default. Included notes can be read by anyone you share the PPTX with.
Up to 100 slides and 512 MiB. Higher resolution uses more memory and storage. Resolution is never reduced automatically.
Could not create this PPTX. Check slide text and images, available memory and storage, then try again.
Delete %1$s from saved projects? Original and exported files are kept.
Clear %1$s and its temporary files? Original files, saved projects and exported files are kept.
Could not clear this work. Wait for processing to finish and try again.
Edit text and images separately. Arial is requested but not embedded; fonts, line breaks and layout may change in other apps. Resolution applies to images.
Editable export supports Latin, Arabic and Persian text. For unverified scripts, emoji or direction controls, choose Keep appearance.
Layout reference; opened PPTX may look different
RTL text uses grouped word and direction-run boxes, each edited separately. Longer edits may need repositioning.

Only supported plain text and cells are copied. Plain copy: layout, formatting, images, charts, merged cells and other sheets are not preserved. Formulas are not calculated. Dates and numbers use raw stored values. Formula text in CSV may be interpreted by other apps. Originals stay unchanged. XLSX copies store all cells as text.
I accept these losses for this conversion or transfer.
Formulas without stored results: %1$d. These cells are blank in value output.
Date serials use the %1$d date system; display formats are not applied.
This Office file is invalid or unsupported. Encrypted, macro-enabled and legacy DOC/XLS files are not supported.
Office limits: 4 MiB compressed / 8 MiB expanded; 16 sheets, 500 rows, 100 columns, 5,000 populated cells; Word: 500 blocks. Complex XML or large output may exceed limits.
VP9 (P0 · SDR) video and Opus sound at 48 kHz. Sound is re-encoded; detail and metadata may be lost. A smaller file is not guaranteed.
Up to 20 images and 512 MiB total. Files are converted one at a time. Originals are kept.
Could not complete this action. Check files, storage and limits. Completed results are kept.
Include %1$d of %2$d files? Failed and unchecked files are excluded. ZIP packaging may increase total size.
Up to 20 files and 512 MiB total; 10 minutes per file. Each whole file is converted separately. Originals are kept.
ZIP: up to 1000 entries, 528 MiB archive, 512 MiB total contents and per file. Available device space may reduce this limit. Keep this screen open; leaving cancels processing.
Encrypted, split, ZIP64 or special ZIP entries are not supported.
The archive contains unsafe or conflicting paths.
The archive exceeds the file count or size limits.
The ZIP is invalid or its contents failed verification.
Could not read or save the file. Check access and available storage.
Clear the private archive copy? Original and saved files are kept.
Keep this screen open while processing.
Up to 20 files, 4 MiB per source: text, CSV/TSV and supported DOCX/XLSX content. PDF input uses the PDF tools. Each file is converted separately; originals are kept.
This target does not support this document type. Choose another target.
Choose a workbook sheet before converting.
The batch output would exceed 512 MiB. No file was shortened.

Selected files go into a new Birlevo folder, keeping their subfolders. Existing files are kept. Keep this screen open. Cancellation or failure removes the new folder when the storage provider allows it; interruption may leave partial files.
Extracted files in the new folder: %1$d.
Some files may remain in the new folder. Check it before retrying:
Not enough device space for a safe working copy. Free space and try again. Originals and completed results are kept.
Current device limit for a new ZIP copy: %1$s. Free space is checked again while working.
Test mode. Checking privacy contacts Google. Your files stay on this device. No live ads.
Privacy check unavailable. File tools remain available.
